dict.string: Marlia needs access to your Desktop to list and manage the files stored there.
Marlia needs access to your Documents folder to list and manage the files stored there.
Marlia needs access to your Downloads folder to list and manage the files stored there.
Marlia — a two-pane file manager for macOS.
Marlia needs access to network volumes to connect to SMB shares and manage the files on them.
Marlia needs access to removable volumes to list and manage the files on connected drives and memory cards.
